name: Elizabeth Krasnoff
abstract: Humans have long sought to alter their mental states through various cultural practices, specifically through the cross-cultural phenomenon of using rhythmic sound to cause altered states of consciousness (American Psychological Association, 2018; Van Pool, 2009). This experiential session will first address the most recent discoveries on the behavioral, perceived, and neural pathways related to the altered states of consciousness elicited by rhythmic sounds, particularly binaural beats (BB). BB
field: Consciousness studies / binaural beats / sound medicine
notable: PhD from California Institute of Integral Studies (CIIS); published in Frontiers in Human Neuroscience
notes: Both CIIS and CIHS are non-traditional institutions.
